subject: Security onboarding & SIG initiation — clarifying items and next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@corehealth.com>, security@corehealth.com, procurement@corehealth.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security onboarding & SIG initiation — clarifying items and next steps

Hi Lena — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the vendor questionnaire (SIG) kicked off so procurement and security can move forward: 

Call recap: 
- Use case: CoreHealth wants Redwood to power anonymized clinical summarization for internal clinician workflows (no direct PHI exported).
- Expected traffic: bursty, ~200 reqs/min peak during daytime hours.
- Desired go-live: September pilot.

Immediate asks/questions from your team we agreed to clarify: 
1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether you have a SOC 2 Type II report covering production hosting for the latest period (and the coverage dates)?
2) Data residency / GDPR: are any EU/UK patient records in scope or will all data be US-resident?
3) HIPAA: is CoreHealth treating Redwood as a Business Associate for this integration (i.e., will PHI be sent to Redwood in production)?
4) SIG vs CAIQ: do you prefer we fill the SIG questionnaire, CAIQ, or a custom form? (we can deliver a prefilled SIG to speed review)
5) Evidence ask: which artifacts are mandatory up front (SOC 2 report, encryption key evidence, data flow diagram, access matrix)? please flag anything procurement needs for contract review.

Proposed next steps: 
- I will attach a SIG prefill template we normally use (SIG_prefill_v2.xlsx) and an evidence checklist. If you can return a short set of clarifications (Q1–Q4 above) and any mandatory procurement docs we’ll start pre-populating the SIG.
- If SOC 2 is available, please attach the report or a redacted copy. If not, tell us the expected timeline.

Timeline: goal is to hand off a completed SIG prefill to your security team within 3 business days of receiving the SOC2 + data residency confirmation.

Attachments: [attachment: SIG_prefill_v2.xlsx (Excel) — prefill template], [attachment: evidence_checklist.txt]

Thanks — I’ve cc'd Neha from our onboarding team who will coordinate evidence ingestion and the HubSpot deal.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Note: Redwood offers a private deployment option for regulated workloads; we can discuss VPC/KMS details if needed.

From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@corehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@corehealth.com, procurement@corehealth.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security onboarding & SIG initiation — clarifying items and next steps

Hi Tessa — great talking earlier. Answers below and attaching our most recent artifacts.

Quick answers: 
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31. I attached a redacted PDF (SOC2_report_2024.pdf). The scope includes our production platform and API gateway but excludes third-party analytics we ingest.
- GDPR/Data residency: CoreHealth stores EU patient data in eu-central-1 for EU customers. For the pilot you'll be integrated with our US tenant (us-east-1). We'll confirm if any pilot customers change that.
- HIPAA: For the planned pilot, we will treat Redwood as a Business Associate; PHI may be processed in limited test exchanges. Procurement will require a BA Agreement.
- SIG vs CAIQ: security@corehealth.com prefers SIG (they find the prefill saves cycles). Please send the prefill; we'll flag any items for evidence.
- Mandatory evidence: procurement needs SOC2 (attached), a data flow diagram (attached), and an authorship/owner list for access controls. Encryption KM: we use KMS (AWS KMS) — we can provide screenshots and KMS key policy excerpts if required.

Attachments: [attachment: SOC2_report_2024.pdf (PDF, redacted)], [attachment: DataFlowDiagram.png (PNG)]

We can target returning the completed SIG to you within 5 business days once you send the prefilled file. Procurement will also start drafting the BA Agreement.

Best,
Lena Brooks
Director, Integrations | CoreHealth Inc
lena.brooks@corehealth.com

Rishi — forwarding CoreHealth's reply and attachments. Key items I need your team to validate before we send the SIG prefill back: 

1) SOC 2 scope: they say production platform + API gateway included. Can we confirm this is sufficient for our hosting claims (esp. for dedicated/durable storage and model weights)?
2) KMS evidence: they indicated AWS KMS. We typically ask for: key policy excerpt, KMS CMK ARN, and a screenshot of key rotation settings. Can your team accept their screenshots and a key policy excerpt as evidence?
3) BA Agreement: procurement will need an initial BAA template. Can we provide a standard Redwood BAA and do you foresee any negotiation hotspots?
4) SIG prefill: I'll attach the prefill (SIG_prefill_v2.xlsx) and the evidence checklist. Once you give a green light on which pieces are mandatory, we'll return the prefilled SIG and request their uploads.

Requested ETA: can your team review and tell me which items you need in-hand vs which can be captured post-contract? We are aiming to hand over a completed SIG to security@corehealth.com by EOD Wed (3 business days).

Forwarded attachments: SOC2_report_2024.pdf, DataFlowDiagram.png, SIG_prefill_v2.xlsx

Thanks — cc'd Neha who will coordinate document ingestion in Drive and the HubSpot deal.

Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: CoreHealth security responses — please review evidence ask and advise on timeline

Thanks for the forward — reviewed the redacted SOC2 and the data flow. Initial notes and plan: 

- SOC2: redacted copy looks acceptable at a glance; scope includes API and production which covers our primary concerns. We should request the control mapping appendix (if available) that ties controls to systems in-scope. Please ask security@corehealth.com for the appendix or a control matrix.
- KMS evidence: screenshots + key policy excerpt are acceptable for initial intake. For final sign-off we prefer either (a) a signed attestation from their infra security owner confirming KMS configuration and rotation, or (b) the key policy + CloudTrail sample showing rotation events. Ask them for the policy excerpt and one recent rotation audit entry.
- BAA: our standard BAA is fine as a starting point. Typical negotiation hotspots: data return/destruction timelines, subprocessor lists, and incident notification SLA. I will draft a BAA redline cheat-sheet for you to share with procurement.

Action items (internal): 
- Rishi to request SOC2 control appendix and KMS rotation audit snippet (ETA: 2 business days).
- Neha to create Drive folder under hubspot deal RDW-4521 and upload the redacted SOC2 + DFD; she will also add the SIG prefill and track CLAs.
- Tessa to send prefilled SIG once we confirm the three evidence items above.

I'll mark this as P1 for the onboarding queue and aim to have the evidence checklist finalized and a short message we can send back to CoreHealth by EOD Tue (3 business days total).

-Rishi
Security Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
